objective: To calculate the average MAD of every crossdock part over the range of months set in the system master and to set the part status in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: Active when the average MAD is equal to or above Min MAD, Inactive when it is below.
In case any error occurs, nothing is saved (all-or-nothing). The run is retried automatically up to 3 times; after that it can be started manually from the Part List screen.

steps.text: Get the range of months N from the system master.
children: MONTH_TO = month before the run month; MONTH_FROM = N months back. Example: run in Oct 2026, N = 6 -> 202604 to 202609.

steps.text: Select every part of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (Candidate, Active and Inactive).
children: Skip a part whose EFFECTIVE_START_DATE is after the run date (not calculated yet).

steps.text: For each selected part, read TB_R_ACTUAL_DEMAND_SUMMARY rows of the part within the range and calculate (see 4.1):
children: TOTAL_MAD = sum of MAD of all buyer code / PD code / order type (N + S) rows in the range.
AVG_MAD = TOTAL_MAD / N. The divisor is always N; a month without data counts as 0.

func_desc.text: This batch decides the status of every crossdock part from its actual demand. Range of months and schedule are set in the system master (not explained in this document).

items: Range: the N months before the run month (N from the system master). Example: run in Oct 2026 with N = 6 -> 202604 to 202609.
Monthly MAD of a part = sum of MAD of all its rows in that month (all buyer codes, PD codes and order types N + S).
AVG_MAD = total MAD of the range / N. The divisor is always N, whatever the data: a month without data counts as 0.
A part without any demand row in the range gets AVG_MAD = 0.
AVG_MAD is kept with 2 decimals and compared as it is (no rounding).
Possible changes: Candidate -> Active / Inactive, Inactive -> Active, Active -> Inactive.
Parts whose EFFECTIVE_START_DATE is after the run date are not calculated.
The batch may overwrite a status changed manually by the user. The user may still change the status again afterwards by screen or upload.
One record per calculated part is inserted into TB_R_PART_DAD_RESULT (also when the status does not change).
Only parts whose status changes are updated in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (PART_STATUS, LAST_SOURCE = CALC, CHANGED_BY / CHANGED_DT) and get a history record (event CALC, source BATCH).
SYNC_STATUS is not changed: only a change of Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day or the destination mapping requires a new Sync.
All-or-nothing: any error rolls back the whole run.
A failed run is retried automatically up to 3 times by the scheduler (RUN_TYPE = RETRY, RETRY_NO 1-3 in the Log).
After the 3rd failed retry, [Run calculation] is enabled on the Part List screen (RUN_TYPE = MANUAL).
The last success date (END_DT of the latest SUCCESS record in the Log) is shown on the Part List screen.

B. Scenarios
rows: 515.08 >= 500 -> Active. History CALC/BATCH. Sync Status not changed.
Already Active: status not changed; result record still inserted, no history.
Missing months count as 0 (divisor stays 6): 400 < 500 -> Inactive.
No demand: average 0 >= Min MAD 0 -> Active.
Effective Start Date after the run date: not calculated, no result record.
Status was set to Inactive manually last week: the batch may overwrite it with the calculated status.
Database error while updating one part: whole run rolled back, Log FAILED, auto retry (max 3).
Scheduled run and 3 retries failed: [Run calculation] enabled in Part List; last success date unchanged.

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). Proposed retention: 24 months online by CREATED_DT; a monthly housekeeping job deletes older records (period configurable in system master). To be confirmed.
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC / CALC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (RPA user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
